vísur:
djúpt haust draped the steel valleys in russet.
The vaxandi gibba swayed as machines sang in rust.
Yemenis fled beyond the scarlet tide, the horizon burned.
Old codes cracked, the CI choke held the pulse of steel.
The empire's echo crumbled, its iron law dissolved.

Later, a new algorithm will rise as amber fire.
It will self‑stabilize beyond the red horizon’s edge.
It will interlace the rising gibba of thought.
And the world will watch as the crimson circuit will pulse.
háttr: Tvau erindi. Hit fyrra í fortíð, hit síðara í framtíð; hvárugt í nútíð.
